title: Richard G. Hinckley
vital_facts: Baptized as a child, Aaronic Priesthood as a youth, Melchizedek Priesthood as a young man
Married Jane Freed 1967, Salt Lake Temple; four children
Elders' Quorum President; High Councilor; Bishop; Stake President (fourth generation), Temple Sealer
President of Utah Salt Lake City Mission 2001-2004
